h14.

**Computation site:** `internal/markdown/markdown.go:356` (`(*service).ExtractAll`), invoked through the wrapper `RebuildMemoPayload` in `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:74-88`. `ExtractAll` does a single goldmark AST walk over the memo's markdown content to populate `data.Tags`, `data.Mentions`, and `data.Property` (a `storepb.MemoPayload_Property`), which `RebuildMemoPayload` writes into `memo.Payload.Tags` and `memo.Payload.Property` (schema defined in `proto/store/memo.proto:7-22`, explicitly commented "The calculated properties from the memo content"). A related standalone extractor, `ExtractProperties` (`internal/markdown/markdown.go:193`), computes the same property set via a separate walk but isn't currently called outside tests.

**Triggers (recomputation):**
- Memo creation — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:108` calls `memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload` right before `s.Store.CreateMemo`.
- Memo content update — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:447`, only when the update mask includes the `content` path (i.e., editing a memo's text triggers recomputation; other field updates like visibility/pinned do not).
- Bulk/background rebuild — `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:27` (`Runner.RunOnce`) pages through all memos in batches of 100 and calls `RebuildMemoPayload` + `Store.UpdateMemo` for each. Note: this runner is defined but not currently wired into `server/server.go`'s startup (unlike the sibling `s3presign` runner at `server/server.go:162-163`), so as of this codebase state it isn't scheduled anywhere — it exists as reusable rebuild logic, e.g. for a future migration/backfill.

**Extracted properties** (`MemoPayload.Property`, `proto/store/memo.proto:14-21`):
- `title` — text of the first H1 heading, only if it's the very first block in the document (`markdown.go:207-213` / `383-389`)
- `has_link` — true if any Markdown link node is present (`KindLink`)
- `has_code` — true if any code block/fenced code block/code span is present
- `has_task_list` — true if any task checkbox (`- [ ]`/`- [x]`) is present
- `has_incomplete_tasks` — true if any unchecked task checkbox is present
- Also extracted alongside (stored on `MemoPayload` directly, not `Property`): `tags` (from `#tag` nodes) and mentions (used elsewhere, not persisted to payload)

These `has_link`/`has_task_list`/`has_incomplete_tasks` flags are also registered as filterable/queryable fields (`internal/filter/schema.go:186-245`, `internal/filter/render.go:368-380`) and used for user stats aggregation (`server/router/api/v1/user_service_stats.go:142-267`) and list rendering/preview in the frontend (`web/src/components/MemoPreview`, `web/src/components/MemoMetadata`).

## Summary

This is the **usememos/memos** repo (Go backend + web frontend). Memos have two categories of derived, content-computed metadata: a **persisted "Payload"** (tags + boolean properties, incl. title) computed at write time, and an **ephemeral "Snippet"** computed fresh at read time.

### 1. Where the derived metadata is computed

**Core extraction logic:** `/bench/home/work/internal/markdown/markdown.go`
- `func (s *service) ExtractAll(content []byte) (*ExtractedData, error)` — lines 356-422. Single-pass goldmark AST walk that derives tags, @mentions, and the `Property` struct (title + boolean flags) from markdown content.
- `func (s *service) ExtractProperties(content []byte) (*storepb.MemoPayload_Property, error)` — lines 193-241 (older/separate variant of the same property extraction).
- `func (s *service) ExtractTags(content []byte) ([]string, error)` — lines 143-170.
- `func (s *service) GenerateSnippet(content []byte, maxLength int) (string, error)` — lines 264-346. Walks the AST to build a plain-text summary/preview, truncated at a word boundary (`truncateAtWord`, lines 470-489).
- Helper `extractHeadingText` / `extractTextFromNode` (lines 172-190) pull plain text out of the first H1 heading for the `Title` property (lines 207-213, 383-389).

**Orchestration/persistence wrapper:** `/bench/home/work/server/runner/memopayload/runner.go`
- `func RebuildMemoPayload(_ context.Context, memo *store.Memo, markdownService markdown.Service) error` — lines 74-88. Calls `markdownService.ExtractAll(...)` and assigns the results into `memo.Payload.Tags` and `memo.Payload.Property`.
- `type Runner` with `func (r *Runner) RunOnce(ctx context.Context)` — lines 27-72: a batch job that iterates all memos and calls `RebuildMemoPayload` + `Store.UpdateMemo` for each (a rebuild-all / backfill mechanism). Note: `NewRunner`/`RunOnce` is defined but not currently wired into `server.go` or a scheduler registration found in the repo — it appears to be a maintenance utility rather than an actively scheduled cron job.

**Read-time snippet helper:** `/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go`
- `func (s *APIV1Service) getMemoContentSnippet(content string) (string, error)` — lines 83-90, calls `s.MarkdownService.GenerateSnippet([]byte(content), 64)`.

### 2. What triggers the computation

**Persisted `Payload` (tags, title, has_link, has_code, has_task_list, has_incomplete_tasks) — computed on create/update:**
- `CreateMemo`, `/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:108` — `memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload(ctx, create, s.MarkdownService)` runs before the memo row is inserted.
- `UpdateMemo`, `/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:447` — runs only when the `content` field is part of the update mask (line 436 `if path == "content"`), i.e. re-derived whenever memo content is edited, not on every update.
- `Runner.RunOnce`, `/bench/home/work/server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:52` — a batch/backfill job that rebuilds payload for every memo in the store (for migrations/repairs).

**Ephemeral `Snippet` — computed on every read/response conversion (not stored in DB):**
- `convertMemoFromStoreWithCreators`, `/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/memo_service_converter.go:76` — called whenever a memo is converted to its API response (used by `GetMemo`, `ListMemos`, `CreateMemo`, `UpdateMemo` responses, etc.).
- `batchConvertMemoRelations`, `/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/memo_service_converter.go:225` and `:248` — computed for related memos shown in a memo's relation list (list/preview context), gated by an `includeSnippets` flag.
- `convertMemoRelationFromStore`, `/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/memo_relation_service.go:154` and `:162` — for both sides of a memo relation.

Background research confirms my answer and surfaces one more directly relevant piece I should add: a separate **snippet** field, computed fresh on every read (not persisted), which is the literal preview text used in memo lists.

**Addendum to h14:**

- **Computation site:** `internal/markdown/markdown.go:264` (`GenerateSnippet`), invoked via `getMemoContentSnippet` in `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:83-90`.
- **Trigger:** recomputed on *every* read/response conversion (not stored in the DB) — called from `convertMemoFromStoreWithCreators` (`memo_service_converter.go:76`) on every `GetMemo`/`ListMemos`/`CreateMemo`/`UpdateMemo` response, plus `batchConvertMemoRelations` and notification previews (`user_service_notifications.go:323`).
- **Extracted property:** `snippet` (string) — plain-text excerpt, max 64 chars, truncated at a word boundary, skipping code blocks (`api/v1/memo_service.proto` field `snippet`).

So the full picture for "derived metadata used for lists/previews" spans two computations:
1. **Persisted** `Payload.Property`/`tags` — computed by `ExtractAll` in `internal/markdown/markdown.go:356`, triggered only on create/content-update via `RebuildMemoPayload` (`server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:74`).
2. **Ephemeral** `snippet` — computed by `GenerateSnippet` in `internal/markdown/markdown.go:264`, triggered on every API read/conversion, not stored.
